svg.title: Maknae agent task lifecycle
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram of an agent task, each step marked live, unreachable, decided or planned: binding recognition, the sealed tasker token, intake and the reach observation in the Egress Daemon, the queue, the agent's claim poll, the hand-out, the agentic loop with the tool-call sequence, the credential's storage and re-mint, the heartbeat and the optional add, ask, approval and stop exchanges, then the report, the revoke and the collect.
svg.text: An agent's task: bindings and reach, the pull hand-off, the agentic loop, the outcome and the revoke
maknaed never dials an agent: maknae-agentd polls until a task is queued for it, then works it in the agentic loop. Each tool call is the one a person makes (generated-tool-invocation.svg).

Inside the loop, the tasker may add to the task, the agent may ask (#736), a tool call may wait for the tasker's approval (#174), and the tasker may stop it; halting its containers is #481. Each step shows its build state.
[until a task is queued for this agent]
1. «live» bind from prompt links and checkout remotes; echo what was not bound
whose forge observes reach; seal the
4. «live» intake: decide session.task, re-validate and seal the bindings
the sealed tasker token, a deadline
11. «live» seal reach (tasker ∩ agent), sign the task, record it, queue it
12. «live» echo what was bound and its
18. «#168» store each minted set's for_revocation blob with the task
re-checking the agent side of reach
33. «#481» stop watch and cancel token halt the task's tool containers within N seconds
«live» built, reachable in production · «unreachable» built, no production caller · «decided» in an ADR, not built · «#N» planned in that issue
GitHub forge token in Vault at <kv_mount>/data/<user_prefix>/<you>/forges/<host>, field token: vault write -wrap-ttl=60s, or maknae forge login <host>. docs/first-provider.md U2
Only hosts of git forges in the subject's catalog bind. A task carries at most 8 bindings; a binding never changes after sealing.
A binding's server must be a current git forge host; a sub-task's binding must equal one of its parent's.
The kernel carries the tasker's token sealed and never opens it. Sub-tasks take the tasker side from the parent's reach.
Every answer but 200 refuses the task, a 404 included. The tasker's token is used for this read only and never stored.
GET /repos is never called with an installation token: its permissions block reads all false (measured 2026-11-19).
Queued in the task store; nothing is sent to the agent. github-machine-user's reach is empty until #168 PR C observes it at hand-out. GitLab tools stay refused in tasks.
Hand-out re-decides the tasker's role and the agent's taskers:, not the tasker's provider reach (ADR-0037 residual 1).
Live for the file tools and sub-tasks. A gh, git or cargo call in a tool container is #479; its mint and launch are the tool-call diagram's steps.
Produced by the mint in the tool-call diagram (steps 11 to 13). The task store has no field for it yet. A rotation of egress's seal key strands every outstanding blob (ADR-0038 residual 2).
Task D3 ruled 2026-11-26: at each launch, when the remaining life is under the call's timeout plus launch time; the old token is revoked at once.
Sent after a step once HEARTBEAT_EVERY has passed; it renews the 15-minute claim lease. A stop or follow-up is seen here.
Refused once the task is Reported. An /add with new bindings repeats steps 5 to 10, reach observed afresh, and is a signed addendum. The agent gets it on its next heartbeat.
At the agent's discretion; this is not an interactive session. The question's shape is open in #736.
The tasker may narrow what the site allows, never widen it. Matching and expiry of an approval are open in #174.
The decision never passes through the agent; the kernel still checks it against the site's authorization.
Cooperative today: the agent sees the stop at its next heartbeat, after its in-flight step.
Task D6 ruled 2026-11-26: conditions 1 to 5 end by construction; 6, a compromised agent, is cut off by the revoke (step 35).
Task D4 and D5 ruled 2026-11-26: every close and move to Held, best effort; the kernel caller is wired with #168 PR C. Each gets a trail intent and outcome (ADR-0038 decision 10).
No kernel caller sends this until step 35 is built; an ADR-0038 as-built line follows then. The reach driver's metadata-read token is already revoked live (step 9).
Open decisions, each with a recommendation for the maintainer's ruling
D1 (step 11). ADR-0037's Owed list still says bindings, reach, recognizers and the intersection are not built; #168 PRs A and B built them, and #674 built binds: and bound-value patterns. Still
owed: session.new bindings (#479), the label claim registry, the mapping from a role level to an installation-token permission set, the re-mint check and enforcing reach. Recommendation: add a
dated as-built status line to ADR-0037.
D2 (step 15). How is a github-machine-user credential observed at hand-out (#168 PR C)? The Egress Daemon holds no KV grant (ADR-0038 decision 5), and the agent reads its own stored token
(ADR-0038 decision 2). Recommendation: a second leg after hand-out, since TaskClaim names no task and doubles as the heartbeat. Once the claim reply names the task and its bindings,
maknae-agentd wrap-reads its stored token for the bound servers only and sends the sealed wrapping token in a follow-up frame that completes the hand-out, so the heartbeat stays free of
credentials (task D3, ruled 2026-11-26). Egress calls GET /repos with it and maps the answer to reach operations as the tasker side is (ADR-0037 decision 7), and the kernel keeps the result as a
hand-out reach record beside the signed task, which recording it does not re-sign; sub-task reach and the task view read that record too. If the leg fails or its frame never arrives, the agent
side is empty and the task acts on nothing (fail closed), with no new close. This assumes a fine-grained token, whose permissions block was measured 2026-10-22; a classic token is unmeasured.
